description: Retro sprites, right on your board. Paint on a 16 to 64 pixel grid with Pencil, Fill, Line and Mirror, pick colours from the PICO-8, Game Boy or NES palette or mix 16 of your own, then click Place on board for a crisp sprite with a transparent background. Switch palettes and every pixel moves to the nearest colour. Select it later to keep drawing. Made for game jams, retros, lessons and sticker-happy boards.
